items.heading: Plov
details: Key ingredients: rice, saffron, lamb, dried fruit, onion
Parboil rice with saffron water until partially cooked.
Saute lamb with onion until browned and tender.
Layer the rice over the lamb in a pot with a little butter.
Steam gently until the rice forms a golden crust on the bottom.

items.heading: Azerbaijani Dolma
details: Key ingredients: grape leaves, ground lamb, rice, mint
Combine ground lamb with rice, herbs and mint.
Roll the mixture in grape leaves into small parcels.
Arrange the rolls in a pot and add a little water.
Simmer until tender and serve with a garlic yogurt sauce.
